issues.explanation: In のである, this surface spans the nominalizing particle の and the continuative copula で; treating it as one particle also gives the wrong causal meaning in context.
issues.suggested_fix: Split into の (particle, lemma の, kana の, “nominalizer”) and で (auxiliary, lemma だ, kana で, “copula connective”), followed by ある.

issues.explanation: Here のである is explanatory/assertive, not the causal conjunction “because; as.”
issues.suggested_fix: Annotate の as “nominalizer” and で as “copula connective”; retain ある as the existential/copular auxiliary.
